# Watchyard

> An unofficial, self-hosted board for many Claude Code accounts on many machines: every session's state, every account's usage limits, and alerts when a session needs you. One Go binary (`wy`) per machine, a hub with a web board, a desktop app and an Android app. Not affiliated with Anthropic. Licensed under AGPL-3.0.

AI agents helping someone set Watchyard up: start with the agent guide. It links the setup procedure and lists what must stay with the person (logins, tokens, the owner key, their network).

## Setup

- [Setting up Watchyard with an AI agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mraj602/watchyard/main/docs/guide/agents.md): where each step is, and what the agent must not do
- [Setup procedure for agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mraj602/watchyard/main/plugin/watchyard/skills/setup/SKILL.md): install `wy`, detect, dry-run, apply
- [Install guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mraj602/watchyard/main/docs/guide/install.md): requirements, the hub on a laptop or a server, HTTPS, more machines
